0x00082B.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x00085D.en: 「With what I've got now...@ this is my limit...!」

0x0009D0.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B80.en: 「Guh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000BBB.en: 「No way I screw up here...!@ This isn't fun...」

0x000C0F.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CF9.en: 「This is as far as I go......!」

0x000D60.en: 「This is my limit... the rest is up to you.」

0x000E0C.en: 「No good, took too many hits...... I'm retreating!」

0x000E59.en: 「Well, this is a bind. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E97.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000EDE.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F89.en: 「Guh...... So I'm the one who falls like a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010C5.en: 「Ngh...! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001179.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x0011AE.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00129A.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still so green...!」

0x0012E8.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013A3.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x0013D2.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001410.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00143F.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave now.」

0x0014CA.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll have to pull back here...!」

0x001547.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x0016EE.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001982.en: Paris, Earth Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x0019B0.en: Earth Federation Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x0019E5.en: 「...Daniel,@ it's only right that my granddaughter's come to dislike you by now.」

0x001A51.en: 「My apologies, Marshal... catching you just as you were heading home.」

0x001A91.en: 「I only hope the matter's settled before my reservation is lost.」

0x001B05.en: 「Yes. I meant to take my granddaughter there for the first time.@　Though this is hardly the moment for that, is it?」

0x001B85.en: 「Indeed... It's intel by way of Vice Admiral Jacob, but@　the Orleans plant of <Mao Industry> was@　attacked by the <Inspectors>.」

0x001C43.en: 「Then Presidential Special Advisor Steinbeck...@　or rather, Extraordinary Vice President now.@　His warning has gained credibility.」

0x001CE2.en: 「Yes. Before long, President Grusman is expected@　to declare Case E.」

0x001D50.en: 「Ho... So the Magician's made his gambit.@　Any change to the candidate sites?」

0x001DA3.en: 「None. Paris remains off the list as well.」

0x001DE0.en: 「Hmph...@　So the Magician means to use not magic, but a 'sword.'@　And right before our eyes, at that.」

0x001E83.en: 「He must be quite confident. Let him do as he pleases.」

0x001EC0.en: 「But that leaves our forces in a difficult position...」

0x001EFA.en: 「The Extraordinary Vice President says he'll show his hand.@　We can sip espresso and enjoy@　an out-of-season Christmas.」

0x001FB7.en: 「...Understood.@　Then I'll issue a high-alert order to all forces.」

0x002016.en: 「Have contingencies ready, just in case.@　Paris included.」

0x00208B.en: 「Now then... I'll have to call the restaurant@　and cancel.」

0x002112.en: 「I passed word of the Inspectors@　to the Joint Chiefs of Staff@　through Vice Admiral Jacob.」

0x002196.en: 「I see.@　Now if only they issue an alert order@　to all forces...」

0x0021F9.en: 「It's already been declared to every theater command.」

0x002236.en: 「Ho... That was quick.@　Looks like the lessons from the <Inspector Incident>@　and the <Shura Rebellion> paid off.」

0x0022BB.en: 「That's part of it, but...@ this time the intel came from the President's own camp.」

0x002336.en: 「The source was most likely 'GS.'@　And the President's people warned the Joint Chiefs@　of a second attack about two weeks ago.」

0x0023F0.en: 「You're saying 'GS' had a read on their movements...」

0x00243C.en: 「The details are unclear, but I believe@　there was some political bargaining involved.」

0x0024AD.en: 「As the <Antarctic Incident> showed,@　the pipeline existed. It may well@　still be connected in some form even now.」

0x00256C.en: 「We'd predicted the Inspectors weren't monolithic...@　but being made a bargaining chip in politics@　is more than one can stomach.」

0x002630.en: 「Also, about the Exbein...@　It's an unauthorized unit, so we can't take it in.@　I'm thinking of leaving it with the Kurogane.」

0x0026E4.en: 「I see...@　That would keep it hidden from the enemy as well.」

0x002734.en: 「I'll meet Ratsel on the way back to Izu.@ It's top secret, so no report goes up.@ Handle the groundwork on your end.」

0x0027FE.en: 「Also, gather intel on the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ the Tsentr Project, and the black-winged one.@ I'll contact you once I reach the Kurogane.」

0x0028E0.en: 「Major Kai...@　is another war with the Inspectors starting?」

0x00295B.en: 「Didn't those guys learn their lesson last time?」

0x00299B.en: 「There are two ways to see it.@　A second attack to make a comeback...@　or a way to show they differ from their predecessor.」

0x002A28.en: 「Either way,@　this won't go like the Inspector Incident did.@　We've learned a thing or two ourselves.」

0x002AF4.en: 「She's leaving the Exbein to your discretion.@ Drs. Hamill and Omiya will go too.@ Development can continue aboard the Kurogane or their base.」

0x002BCC.en: 「Understood.@　And... did you urge her to come down to Earth?」

0x002C31.en: 「The President said she'll stay to protect headquarters.@　But Ms. Radha will be sent to Earth soon@　with the Exbein's parts.」

0x002CE8.en: 「Then please have her hurry as much as possible.@　But if something happens, tell her to stay on the Moon.」

0x002D78.en: 「Then... once the Exbein is loaded,@　we'll depart from here.」

0x002E0F.en: 「Major Kai. We'll be over Lepan Island shortly.」

0x002E49.en: 「Understood. All units, board and stand by.」

0x002E80.en: 「Huh, why?@　Lamia and Lat are already out there...」

0x002EDC.en: 「Because if I were the enemy, I'd strike during the handoff.@　Don't forget they come from overhead...@　and by spatial teleport, at that.」

0x002F81.en: 「Major Kai, sensor contact!@　Twelve o'clock, multiple moving signatures over Lepan Island!」

0x002FEC.en: 「Below us?　All units, board now! We're launching!」

0x00302F.en: 「Moving signatures at twelve o'clock are intensifying.@　And their numbers keep growing.」

0x003091.en: 「Major Kai, this is like the Mizudori Island case.」

0x003184.en: （It seems there's no mistake...@　the Machinery Children are after something@　in my unit.）

0x0031F9.en: （And it's most likely Hugo's group or Joshua's...@　one or the other, or possibly both.）

0x00327C.en: 「Hey, Hugo.@　Could it be the Machinery Children are after us...?」

0x0032E4.en: 「If so, then why didn't they show@　when we were heading to Izu alone?」

0x003352.en: 「True... if they meant to do something to us.@　Then is it Joshua's side...?」

0x0033BA.en: 「We were on our own from Antarctica to Izu too, though.」

0x003425.en: （No, wait...@　before and after leaving Antarctica, I never@　activated the Aile Chevalier.）

0x0034DD.en: 「All units, commence attack!@　Don't let the Machinery Children near the transport!」

0x00352D.en: 「Ngh, the transport took a hit!@　All units, keep the enemy away from it!」

0x003595.en: 「...Same as that time, no real change.@　But if that person said this may be one of the 'keys'...」

0x00362E.en: 「Those who face me die, those who stay perish, gods fall and demons rise,@　machine-men reborn, swift as the law commands... by decree!」

0x0036E9.en: 「Look! Around Lima 1 and Lima 2 as well!」

0x003723.en: 「This is bad! Shoot them down, quick!!」

0x003857.en: 「I learned of the battle in this airspace and raced ahead in Trombe.@　The Kurogane will arrive later.」

0x003912.en: 「No progress, is it.@　Let's pull out for today...」

0x003962.en: 「...Looks like they're not coming out anymore, the Machinery Children.」

0x0039A2.en: 「Still, for all the trouble they stir up,@　they're all small fry. And yet the <Super Machine Children>@　showed up at Tesla Labs...」

0x003B32.en: 「Yeah. The Yokijin, the Orleans incident...@ There's a strong chance another major conflict is about to begin.」

0x003BD1.en: 「By the way, Sanger and the others -@　have you turned up any leads on your end?」

0x003C6E.en: 「But I believe they're safe.@　The whole Steel Dragon Squadron included.」

0x003CF8.en: 「A member of the old Special Tactics Instructor Squad,@　and a former top ace of the <Colony Integration Army>.」

0x003D68.en: 「Whaat!?　@　Then that's the 'Black Whirlwind,' Major Elzam!?」

0x003DC4.en: 「I am no longer Elzam.@　I am Ratsel Feinschmecker.」

0x003E51.en: 「Hey, Hugo! That's a totally different guy!@　Quit feeding her nonsense!」

0x003F00.en: 「Major Kai,@　the Kurogane will be arriving shortly.@　If you'd like, you may land aboard.」

0x003F72.en: 「Understood.@　All units, escort Lima 1 and Lima 2.」

0x004006.en: 「It's <Super> class in size... but that shape...」

0x004042.en: 「That! That right there! You know, the Japanese... uh...」

0x0040CA.en: 「That coloring, that form, it's just like...」

0x004168.en: 「To catch him off guard like that!」

0x0041AB.en: 「Ngh...@　That speed closing in, that fluid movement!」

0x004266.en: 「No. That's most likely an unmanned unit...@　And its target is my Trombe...@　the Aussenseiter.」

0x0042FD.en: 「Major, I'll draw that machine off alone.@　I'll need your cover.」

0x004359.en: 「...Understood.@　Lima 1 and Lima 2, withdraw and rendezvous with the Kurogane!@　Everyone else, cover Ratsel!」

0x004402.en: 「The ninja robot stopped moving! Now's our chance!」

0x0044CF.en: 「A p-powerful EA!　@　Radar and sensors are useless!」

0x0045F5.en: 「That thing was built for one purpose -@　to destroy the Dynamic General Guardian...」

0x00469D.en: 「Lord Ratsel, I've come to collect you.」

0x0046D7.en: 「Well done, Captain.@　...Major Kai, let's continue this aboard the Kurogane.」

0x004746.en: 「Such fluid movement despite that size...!@　It's just like a Double G!」

0x0047B4.en: 「Could it be that machine was developed by...!?」

0x0047F4.en: 「The frame structure and shifting center of gravity are alike...@　The EG line, and... the Double G.」

0x00486B.en: 「First a black Huckebein knockoff,@　now a black ninja... just what are you people!?」

0x0048E5.en: 「Achieving that motion at Super class size takes@ the ABMD system... and given the parts layout@ and center shift, the answer is...!」

0x004A37.en: 「'I am Jinrai...@　the Dynamic General Guardian,@　and the one who surpasses it.」

0x004AB5.en: 「My purpose is to destroy Units 1 and 2.'@　That's what it said.」

0x004B0B.en: 「Th-that thing's@　a Dynamic General Guardian too!?」

0x004BA7.en: 「If the ABMD system used in the DyGenGuard@　is also installed in Jinrai...@　then that fluid movement makes sense.」

0x004C5E.en: 「Yeah, its center of gravity shifted like a Double G's too.」

0x004CCC.en: 「Originally, in Dr. Bian Zoldark's plans,@　four Double Gs were to be built.」

0x004D46.en: 「But the only ones actually made were the DyGenGuard@　and my Aussenseiter...」

0x004DB4.en: 「Units 3 and 4 were assembled up to the B-frame,@　but development was halted.@　Later they were disassembled... and went missing.」

0x004E59.en: 「So then, who on earth built that thing...?」

0x004E90.en: 「And why go after the Aussenseiter?@　Even announcing it beforehand...」

0x004F10.en: 「Jinrai... was it? Which is it closer to in spec,@　the Double G's Unit 3 or Unit 4?」

0x004FAA.en: 「Then, anyone come to mind who@　could have built Jinrai?」

0x005006.en: 「Dr. Jonathan Kazahara of Tesla Labs,@　Dr. Omiya over there...」

0x00507B.en: 「For the record, I've got nothing to do with it.」

0x0050AC.en: 「I know.@　And then, Dr. Eric Wong...」

0x00514F.en: 「Yeah... back when I was with the Cry Wolves,@　I met him at Fort 1 of the Zentral Project.」

0x0051EB.en: 「Is Dr. Wong still with the Zentral Project?」

0x00527B.en: 「Dr. Kisaburo Azuma,@　and... Dr. Kaoru Tomine.」

0x0052DD.en: 「Dr. Tomine.@　He was with the <EOTI Agency>, if I recall.@　A man famous for being difficult.」

0x005363.en: 「And he took part in the <DC> as well...@　In the field of combat AI, they said he@　even surpassed Dr. Bian.」

0x005414.en: 「After clashing with Dr. Bian and leaving the DC,@　his whereabouts became unknown.」

0x00547C.en: 「Clashing, you say...@　Could he have harbored rivalry toward Dr. Bian?」

0x0054E7.en: 「Yes... along with envy and obsession.@　He bitterly hated Dr. Bian.」

0x005555.en: 「You think Dr. Tomine is the prime suspect, then.」

0x0055BA.en: 「So Dr. Tomine, after all this time,@　to settle his grudge against Dr. Bian...」

0x00562E.en: 「Aims to destroy the Double Gs, Bian's legacy?@　And with what amounts to Unit 3, no less?」

0x0056A8.en: 「It's highly possible, but...@　there's one thing that doesn't sit right.」

0x0056F8.en: 「That he gave Jinrai the title of@　Dynamic General Guardian -@　the very thing it should despise?」

0x005788.en: 「Yes.@　The advance message he sent us,@　in a way, does seem like him, but...」

0x005815.en: 「Assuming you're right, where on earth would@　Dr. Tomine have gotten his hands on such a thing?」

0x00588C.en: 「There are several candidates.@　Isurugi Heavy Industries, the Neue DC remnants,@　the Zentral Project...」

0x00591C.en: 「And 'GS.' I've heard they're developing and@　testing new weapons on the former <Aidoneus Island>...@　on Grand Christmas.」

0x0059E7.en: 「Besides, 'GS,' being under the President's direct command,@　has just cause to strike down someone like me,@　who once took part in the DC.」

0x005A80.en: 「In any case, there's the Yokijin and the Inspectors to consider.@　Let us take you to the seas off Japan aboard the Kurogane.」
